decisions.reason: The mitred handle family embodies the firm's proprietary engineering and design identity, and after only two years in architects' specifications its development investment and brand commitment still argue for persistence despite modest visibility.

The multifunctional handle is central to the announced barrier-free system direction, so management attributes slow uptake to long construction specification cycles rather than a failure of the product.
The line is embedded in coordinated handle families and planning documentation, and having just dropped Product A, management is reluctant to admit another misjudgement so soon.
The collection won a design award, has its own page and was publicly showcased, so its strong visible commitment and positive results make withdrawal very unlikely.
The finish is cheap to maintain, spans several product families and supports the firm's finishing expertise and its sustainability-oriented material story.
